name: Coasters Bar and Restaurant
description: A bar and restaurant in the park with a balcony view of ICON. The menu covers breakfast plus Italian and Mexican/Tex-Mex dishes such as lasagne and burritos, making it a relaxed sit-down stop between rides.

items.name: Burrito
items.description: Mexican-style burrito with filling of the day

items.name: Full English Breakfast
items.description: Traditional cooked breakfast served in the morning

name: Loki's Restaurant and Après Ski Bar
description: A Norse-themed restaurant and après ski bar beside the Valhalla water ride, serving rotisserie chicken with sides and drinks. A hearty sit-down meal in a themed setting.

items.name: Chicken Meal with Fries
items.description: Chicken portion with chips and a side

name: Big Pizza Kitchen
description: An all-you-can-eat buffet of pizza, pasta and salad on the edge of Nickelodeon Land. Vegetarian, gluten-free and children's options are available, which makes it an easy choice for families.

name: White Tower Restaurant
description: A traditional restaurant on the top floor of the Casino Building, with views over the promenade, local produce, a sunken bar and a terrace. Private dining is available for up to 20 guests. Prices here are estimates.

items.name: Main Course of the Day
items.description: Traditional dish made with local produce
